class.name: SphereVoxelEdit
class.brief_description: An edit that fills a hypersphere with one material.
class.description: SphereVoxelEdit fills a hypersphere of the given center and radius with one material.

members.member: The center of the sphere, in voxel coordinates.
The radius of the sphere, in voxels.
The material the sphere is filled with: [code]1[/code] for air, carving matter out, or [code]2[/code] and above for the opaque materials, adding matter.
